Hide the model's meshes (buildMesh's `prim`) instead -- Chameleos's full cloak.
101. **A class's shells can live outside every action body (2026-10-18).** cengen11 over Lao-Shan Lung's 16 statuses finds no create: his shells are records of a per-frame list (vt+0x2a8 0xd759f4) the action start selects from an index the EMC's op 0xa3 sets. An empty census means: grep the class's vt+0x2a8 / +0x1dc and its table walkers before calling it shell-less.
102. **One class, several monsters: the command table decides which actions each plays (2026-10-18).** uEm013_00's census under variant 0 showed Crimson's meteors (sp_00 0x86) -- actions only variant 1 issues. Walk the EMC with op 0x92 (the variant switch) evaluated and close it over the set-action calls (fb/emcvar.py, chain013.py); the control: every reached action makes only its own variant's ids.
103. **A shell's EffectParam list is ITS .shl's list order, not the monster's (2026-10-18).** Kushala's sp_01 lists (em024_00c, em024_00u): its list 0 is c -- u 29..35 are c's UNIQUE keys, and 120 / 130 u's. Taking the monster's (u, c) made the export look for keys the array does not hold. Read the .shl's EffectLists (fb/shl.py prints them in order).
104. **emu_fb's frame step [[0x211f764]+0x68] is NULL unless the case names it (2026-10-18).** The global pointer is 0 in the harness, so any code that adds the frame step (Kushala's base34 sway clock +0x1378) adds 0 and the run looks frozen next to the module's dt. A case's `frameStep: 1.0` sets it (fb/emu_fb.py).
105. **emu_fb stubs the current-action test 0x6fe88 to 0 (2026-10-18).** A shell or a vt+0x208 arm that asks "is the action (s, n)" never sees it in the harness: Teostra's L0 M5 blast for (1, 7) and every leading powder's trigger were absent from the ROM runs until the cases named `unstub: ['0x6fe88']`. Grep the band for `bl #0x6fe88` before calling a ROM run's silence a negative. (T)
106. **A module spawn is one step after the frame it tests (2026-10-18).** shells.js's line-4 tests the previous advance (F[k-2], F[k-1]], so a shell spawned for frame F is made at the step after F; its move k is the step at F + k. A harness input keyed on a step (actionAt) must count from there, or the trigger lands a move early. (T)
107. **A shell made by the last unit of line 18 has its hit slot counted before its first move (2026-10-18, module order INFERRED).** The walk stops at the unit that was last when it started, then the hit pass counts every slot: a lone leader's first child lives one move less than its siblings. (T; the ROM's own hit-pass order is not read.)
108. **emu_fb answers every `0xb0968` with the step's `win` (2026-10-19).** A helper with two b0968 tests in one call (Alatreon's (7, 0x1a) at f70 and f164) passes both under `win: 1`; name `winFrames: [F]` so only that frame's test passes. (T)
109. **A maker's zero setup point in trgen's run can be the owner's point (2026-10-19).** trgen's owner sits at the origin, so `+0x10 = (0, 0, 0)` is either the GOT's zero vector or the owner's +0x40 copied: read the maker's loads before transcribing (Alatreon's sp_01 / sp_11 makers do both). (T)
110. **An empty census can mean the phase byte is elsewhere (2026-10-19).** Amatsu's actions switch on e+0x15e1, not P+0x1a1: cengen11 ran every phase into phase 0's setMotion and found no create. Before calling a class shell-less, read its first status-7 helper's phase load (FB_PHASEAT). (G: the phase byte is a class's choice; T: our tools assumed P+0x1a1)
111. **A chain walk must follow the VIRTUAL change (2026-10-19).** Class helpers change action through vt+0x3d0 (uEnemy `0x6c178` = `b 0x768c8`); a tracer that stubs out-of-band calls never sees it, and e+0x7420 (this machine owns the monster; offline set) gates some chains. Amatsu's "not reached" six, Kushala's (7, 4 / 0x41) and Alatreon's (7, 0x48 / 0x4d / 0x4f..0x51) were all chain-issued. Run fb/chainx.py (old vs fixed) before calling an action unissued; a direct-call scan (zg/issuers.py) needs the vt+0x3d0 form too. (G: changes are virtual; T: our tracer stubbed them)
112. **A tracer's stub answers are game state (2026-10-19).** trgen answered the tired test 0x81614 and two of the three rage tests 0 (0x81688 / 0x816b8); Mizutsune's / Hermitaur's / Lavasioth's makers are TIRED-GATED (fb/cen3.py lists them). Walk and census at rage 0 / 1 x tired 0 / 1 (fb/chainx.py, fb/cen3.py; zg/recheck.sh). **Worked example (the effects agent's):** tracec.py answered `0x81670` with 0, so a follow that picks `movne #a / moveq #b` on it (0xf40104) showed only the calm form -- Brachydios's (7, 0xa6), the enraged twin of (7, 0xa5), read as "no issuer". (G: actions and spawns gate on rage and fatigue; T: our stubs)
113. **A new shell unit runs vt+0x18 before its first move (2026-10-19).** The unit walker activates it (state 1 -> 2, vt+0x18) and moves it in the same pass; base42 starts its effect there, and emu_fb's harness never called it until `activate`. Check vt+0x18 (fb/vt18.py) before trusting a flown shell's starts. (G: the activation; T: our harness skipped it)
114. **A generated check can lose a comparison to its own patch (2026-10-19).** A replacement that put a `//` comment before the rest of a line commented out the at-once-stop comparison in two checks; the next `return null` hid it. After patching a check, grep the patched line. (T)
116. **Stops go out only with a shell that stays (2026-10-19).** The runtime applies a shell's `stops` for its ended / alive shells; a shell set to 0xff in the step that pushes them is removed and the stops are lost (Amatsu's splashes piled up, 13 a play). Delete as the ROM does: after the handles are EMPTY (their units out of states 1 / 2), not when they were told to stop. (T)
115. **A viewer seek is a release the game never makes (2026-10-19).** clearClipEffects hard-releases every running clip request, and Nakarkos's em084_00_050 / _007 generators then take 0xa55ea8's unrecorded +0xb8 arm: a step back during ANY Nakarkos idle throws (HEAD too). A soak that never seeks will not find it: probe a step back with a long record live (armseek.mjs). (T: the viewer's seek; G: the destructor's free list) [Recorded 2026-10-19 with vecdrawsched's `<frame>:release:<n>`: record the release the viewer makes, not only the stop.]
117. **A census with the class's control block zeroed hides creates gated on it (2026-10-19).** Chaotic Gore Magala's footfall dust (0xfb700c, sp_01 1) passes only with C+0x84 (`[e+0xcac0]+0x84`) at 20000 or more: the census (C zeroed) found none of his calls (10 actions), Shagaru's identical calls (no gate) all. Before calling a maker unreached, read its gate and poke the field (fb/ff071.py: 15000 none, 20000 one). Worked example and rows: gore-line-shells-spec 2.3.
118. **A census action's reach needs the class code's own changes, timers answered (2026-10-19).** Walking the command table (op 0x92 evaluated, ops 0x20 / 0x14 followed) misses every action the class enters itself: Bloodbath's (7, 0x62), which no table op names, is entered from (7, 0x68) / (7, 0x85) by `mov r2, #0x62` + vt+0x3d0 (0xd40ee8), but only after the phase-2 timer 0x7206c and e+0x7420 -- which the tracer answers 0, so cengen11's CHG lines never log it. fb/chgpass.py (timer 1, e+0x7420 1) does; fbbcmp.mjs closes the table's reach over its edges. A "not in his reach" negative stands only on that closure (control: Bloodbath's (7, 0x62) / (7, 0x6b) reached).
119. **A shell id the census logs 0 is a class reading its ids from enemy fields (2026-10-19).** The Rath line (e+0xcac4..cacc, its loader 0xd09918) and uEm004_00 (e+0xcac4..cad0, 0xd2e538) fill them at load; the tracer never runs the loader, so every create logs id 0 and a comparison on (action, mode) alone matches any shell of the monster. Poke the loader's ids (runfbb.py RATH) before trusting such a census.
120. **A start / loop clip's page pick is its _loop (2026-10-19).** The viewer has no combined entry for Motion[46]_start + _loop: picking _start loops its own 8 frames and never reaches Gravios's f105; the _loop clip carries the start's offset. A page check that falls back to `name + '_start'` on such a clip watches the wrong clip.
121. **A census of action mains misses the per-frame shells (2026-10-19).** cengen11 runs a class's action main; a shell made by a per-frame vtable method keyed on the motion id (Tigrex's frame handler vt+0x208: shell01 on L0 M28 / L1 M1 / L1 M2 / L2 M8) never appears in it, and the triage reads "no creates" for a class that has them. Run `fb/pfgen.py` (every overriding slot in +0x190..+0x240 x every motion id) before calling a monster's shells complete.
122. **A monster's clips are its monsters.json lists, not `<mon>_N.glb` (2026-10-19).** A variant's lists 0..3 are often its base's files (Grimclaw plays em032_00_0..3.glb; Basarios shares lists with Gravios): a tool that globs the pose folder by the monster's own stem files every create on a shared list as "no clip of his" and skips those motions in a per-motion census. fbbcmp.mjs and pfgen.py had it; both now read `lists[].file`.
123. **trgen answers `0x9d36c` (a part's break level) 0 and leaves the `.dtp` unmapped (2026-10-19).** A maker that tests a break level against `[[e+0x75f0]+0x64]` reads its threshold off text bytes and takes the BROKEN arm: Seregios's first census read modes 9 / 8 / 7 for every play of L2 M26 / M34 / M65, which the game gives only with part 4 / the head broken (2 / 1 / 0 otherwise). Poke the .dtp rows and answer the level per run; FB_WATCH=0x9d36c names the part.
124. **A phase's mode can be the previous phase's ctl (2026-10-19).** Seregios's (7, 0x11) / (7, 0x12) write ctl+0x70 = 1 in phase 0 and their phase-1 shots read it (7 / 13, not 0 / 6); a standalone phase-1 run (ctl zeroed) gives the sibling action's modes. Run phase 0 first and carry ctl and the block.
125. **A census with the clocks at 0 misses the clock-gated creates (2026-10-20).** trgen answers the timers `0x7264c` / `0x7206c` with 0 and zeroes the ctl block, so a maker gated on a ctl clock (Kut-Ku's (7, 0x02) phase 2: C+0x10 += dt, >= 16.0 -> sp_01 6) never fires in it -- the triage read Kut-Ku as having no sp_01 maker in any action. Sweep every action x phase with the clock fields primed (`fb/k08m6.py`), and check the clock's other writers (vt+0x1dc) for the order before calling a gate reachable or dead.
126. **The triage's frame list is not the maker's (2026-10-20).** neset/triage_all2.txt listed Garuga's (7, 0x0a) at f120 / f164, both mode 1; the maker `0xdac748` tests 78 / 120 / 164 and counts its shots (P+0x1a2) into the mode table -- three shots, modes 1 / 2 / 3, and a single-frame run per literal shows each as the first. Read the maker (its frame literals and any counter) before taking the census's frames and modes as the row.
127. **A ROM check that hands the hit slots does not show the page's shell has them (2026-10-20).** The harness's slot0Until holds slot 0 per id:mode, so the ROM run and the JS run in the check both live on the harness's slots. The page's shell lives on S.slots, which only the maker sets (slotsOf011 from the shell's hitdata). Crystalbeard's spawn045 never set them. And SHELL_DATA.em032_00 had no hitdata, so the slots were refused by name. Both checks passed, while the page ended those shells on their first move: Crystalbeard u 60 / 62 and Tigrex c 32 drew nothing. The draw meter found them. Worse, the Crystalbeard harness held the wrong id (227, not 226), so even the ROM run ended its shards at once and the check compared two wrong lives. Audit: `<archive>\fb\hdquick.mjs` / `b00quick.mjs` over every monster (shells that end on move 1 with no slots and no start, and hitdata refusals). After the two fixes only Hellblade's sp_03 9..11 / 18..20 remain, and the ROM ends those early too (em080 spec).
128. **A class event kind fires on any motion (2026-10-20).** The walker 0x6c590 tests the row's motion (0xb0950) only on kinds 1..13. Kinds above 13 go to the class's vt+0x47c with no motion test. A row's motion field then says nothing about when it fires: Neset's (7, 0xa) type-14 rows are filed under L0 M1, yet they fire 144 frames into L2 M36, on his object's clock. Reading the row dump's motion column as the clip to attach such a row to would have put the shots on the wrong clip.
129. **A per-frame request may carry the ZERO vector as its words (2026-10-20).** Nargacuga's 0xe47b0c loads +0x30.. from [GOT 0x18321b0] = 0x1620e60 (zero) where Tigrex's 0xe21294, Malfestio's and Gravios's hand the owner's words: reusing perFrame079 / perFrame032 as-is would turn his impact. Read the +0x30 load; do not copy a sibling's shape.
130. **A census on zeroed memory hides a maker gated on the class's own state (2026-10-20).** Gammoth's leg snow (0x105fd94: sp_01 3..6, u 60 / 61) passes only when 0x1053d8c finds a snow slot e+0xcb50.. at 1..3. trgen zeroes the enemy, so every slot read 0 (bare) and the census and the per-frame census both missed five actions. The trunk's 0x1060e28 had the same gate. When a mode in the files has no maker, scan the band for its setup's +8 immediate first (gapG/static_scan.py), then prime the state the gate reads.
131. **trgen's ray stub writes no hit byte (2026-10-20).** `0x183664`'s hook in fb/trgen.py writes `b''` to the stack's hit-byte pointer and returns s0 = 0, so every create gated on the ray's hit byte is skipped and a census reports the action as making nothing. Old Fatalis's storm 0xd87630 (sp_01 0x8b mode 9, (7, 0x50) phase 4) was missed that way; gapA\emu50.py answers the byte. Same family as trap 105 (a stub answering 0 hides an arm): a census "nothing makes mode N" needs the ray and the hunter getter (0x27482c, answered 0) checked first.
132. **trgen's stubs give one answer per address.** Code that calls the same query twice and branches on the second answer (`0x1095114`: `0xa6c48` x 2) never takes that arm. Answer the calls in sequence (`gapD\cen3iss.py` `Seq`). (2026-10-20, gapD)
133. **chainx.py walks phases 0..5 only.** A follow in phase 6+ (Valstrax's comet, `0x109ac48`) is invisible to it. (2026-10-20, gapD)
134. **A constant `reference` Y can be an airborne unit's authored height (2026-10-21, gapK).** Kecha Wacha's hang clips (L2 M126 584.5, M117 400.2): the viewer draws it as pose but unitGamePos keeps the mixer root's Y; an AIR_HEIGHT `at` row (the ground H below the origin) has the wrong sign there -- use `hang` (the ground at the origin, the unit H above).
135. **`armdis.py` stops at the first undecodable word in a band: use `jdis.py` (skipdata)** (2026-10-21, gapJ)
136. **Don't name a file `dis.py`: it shadows stdlib `dis` and breaks capstone's import** (2026-10-21, gapJ)
137. **The page's first step after a clip is selected already shows frame 1 or 2 (2026-10-21).** shells.js stepShells began a fresh motion's frame history there, so a row at frame 1 / 2 was never crossed on the page while every node check (stepping from 0) passed: Thunderlord's (7, 0xdb) L9 M4 f2, Chaotic Gore's (7, 0x2f) L2 M25 f1. FIXED: a play from the clip's start (no loop piece, frame <= 2) is taken from 0. Test a frame-1 / 2 row on the page, not only in node.
138. **A split clip's pick advances only on its _start (2026-10-21).** A _loop selection continues the play before it (rockInput's goesOn), so metering the _start n times and then the _loop n times shows the _loop only the last _start's pick (Kushala's L2 M9 (7, 0x2d), Alatreon's (7, 0x40)): play _start then _loop as one pair per pick (shellmeter.mjs).
139. **dtbase +0x6c is file +0x1d, unaligned.** The fields are read one by one off a stream, so object offsets do not map linearly to file offsets. (2026-10-22, gapL)
140. **P+0x380 is two things at once:** the code-0x1a threshold, and an HP floor that applies to every monster. Ka has a floor but no code 0x1a. (2026-10-22, gapL)
141. **A mode's hit record is not its mode number (2026-10-22, gapO).** It is int 0 of the HitParam FUP its ShellInfoList entry names (0x4a23f4): em033_00 mode 6 -> _hit006 = [5], em010_00 mode 15 -> [4]. Read the FUP; do not index hitrec by mode.
142. **A "below the viewer's floor" shell is two numbers, and the floor is usually the stand-in (2026-10-22, gapP).** On a clip whose bones go under the origin the lowest-reach floor follows the lowest bone (Chameleos L2 M45: the tongue), so "12 below the floor" read as "the head at the ground" when the head was 297 under the unit's ground. Measure the spawn against the UNIT (the clip origin) on a posture-0 clip before reading the floor.
143. **A command-table stream can issue the same action in two branches, and a P+0x3b4 read can name no offset (2026-10-22, cv).** Chameleos's g1 s49 issues (1, 3) in the case-0 branch of a dead selector AND again in its else; reading the first and calling the action "refused" missed the regular cloak. Grep every `00 st n` of an action, with its enclosing blocks, before calling an issue gated. And `mov rX, #0x3b4; ldrh rY, [rP, rX]!` is a P+0x3b4 read a `#0x3b4]` regex never sees (vt+0x24c 0xe01fb8, the sever 0xc22dc): search the immediate, not the operand.
144. **tune_emu.Loader ends every dtbase run with "fault ... 3885957120" (a fetch at 0xe79f0000).** It still consumes the whole file and returns 0: INFERRED the harness's return, not a loader failure. (2026-10-22, gapL; `<archive>\gapL\RESULT.md`) [doc audit 2026-10-24]
145. **A census that stubs the class's own probes sees no slime at all (2026-10-25, gapQ).** cengen11 on uEm063_00 found 5 actions with creates (the sp_11 lines only): the fist probes 0xf454e0 / 0xf3e7a8 run natively and fail on the stubbed ray, the sp_35 allocator 0x41876c is not one trgen serves, and the status-3 handlers branch on the motion id (0xb0944), not the phase. With the probes answered (`<archive>\gapQ\trgen063.py`), 0x41876c served and `mot` swept (`st3b.py`), 73 status-7 actions, 6 status-3 handlers and the frame handler make shells. Answer a class's own probe before calling a maker unreached. And the 0x30 request (0x41876c / 0x3f883c) carries its WORDS at +0x20, the 0x40 shape (0x3fa2bc) at +0x30.
146. **A viewer timer's state is AFTER its step; the ROM's consumer runs before the state turns (2026-10-25, Brachydios).** motion-states.js slime063 marks a slot `spent` (Yellow) on the step its fuse burns out, but 0xf46234 explodes while the slot is still Red (its countdown -1 turns it Yellow the next tick). Reading the timer's slot states on that step refused every eruption. And one timer step is one viewer frame: an event flag on the input lives for every game frame the shells step inside it -- take it once by its sequence number. [2026-10-25 later: the effects lane rebuilt slime063 to 0xf36100's machine -- the RAW state 0..3, unchanged through the fuse, the countdown -1 turning it the next step -- so the burn-out step now carries the state 0xf46234 tests and eruptStep063 reads it as it is (the forced Red is removed); the seq-once rule stands: one slot can erupt again after the viewer's 60-frame re-arm, each with a new seq.]
147. **A one-UV mesh's second UV is its first; a missing glb attribute is not a zero UV (2026-10-25, Raging Brachydios).** The ROM's input layouts (docs/effects/model-shaders.json `layouts`; a .mod mesh's format id's low byte is the layout index) put UV_Secondary / UV_Unique / UV_Extend on the SAME bytes as UV_Primary in every one-TexCoord layout (IASkinTB*, IASkinTBC*); the glb export then has no TEXCOORD_1, and a shader that declares `attribute vec2 uv1` reads the constant (0, 0) -- one texel over the whole mesh, with no error anywhere. Raging's MapBlend slime (blend map @ UVSecondary) drew flat amber at Red. Fixed by aliasing `uv1` to `uv` on every two-map albedo (TypeExtend* / MapBlend) with no TEXCOORD_1 (monster.js buildMesh). **The audit the same day (every two-map primitive, `<scratchpad>/slimefix/audit/uvcensus.py`: the .mod mesh matched by TEXCOORD_0, its layout, the byte offset of the slot the material's second map samples, and what the glb carries):** (a) one-TexCoord layouts with no TEXCOORD_1 -- em045_04 (+ head, tail) ore, em063_05 slime, em080_00 / em080_04 / em081_04's TB / TBC prims -- the alias (the ROM reads UV_Primary's bytes); (b) TBN layouts carry their second TexCoord: TBN1wt UV_Extend @20, TBN2wt @24, TBN4wt @28 -- em080_00 meshes 16 / 17 (TBN1wt) had NO TEXCOORD_1 although the .mod has it (the export's +8 lands past the stride): ADDED from @20 (mesh 17's differs from uv0 on 60 of 84 vertices); (c) the TBNLA layouts' UV_Secondary is NOT the tail: TBNLA1wt UV_Unique @20 / UV_Secondary @24 / UV_Extend @28, TBNLA2wt 28 / 24 / 32, TBNLA4wt 28 / **32** / 36 -- the 8-byte "dead field" dev/add-uv2.py names IS UV_Unique + UV_Secondary, all zero in these models, and add-uv2 writes the tail (UV_Extend) into TEXCOORD_1. Right for every UVExtend material (em032_00, em032_04, em033_00, em081_00, em084_00: match); WRONG for the one UVSecondary material on a TBNLA mesh, **Khezu's XfBA_A0__m03_blood (em003_00 mesh 0, TBNLA4wt): the ROM samples (0, 0)** -- its second map (tex c0260af4797caf3c, 128 x 128) is a U RAMP (column spread 2.5 vs row 38.8: black -> teal -> black) and every clip scrolls fUVTransform2 U -0.5 -> 0.5, i.e. the whole layer pulses through the ramp in time, not a band moving across the veins. TEXCOORD_1 rewritten to the .mod's @32 (zeros); (d) em081_00 mesh 20 prim 2 (8 vertices) matched three .mod meshes with the same uv0 (10 / 77 / 80) and its TEXCOORD_1 equals 77's and 80's UV_Extend: ambiguous, left. The re-export: `<archive>\uv1\patch_uv1.py` (originals identical to HEAD); dev/add-uv2.py (both copies) now skips UVSecondary materials, so a re-run leaves Khezu's zeros (report-only over all 180 models: 0 to patch). **What changed on screen** (same-frame A/B in the fix page, uv1 removed vs kept -- run-to-run noise 0): em045_04 ore 8132 px calm and enraged (the ore spots on head and tail); em080_04 blood 4205 px enraged (0 calm: the layer is off); em080_00 angry 247 px enraged; em063_05 Red Slime 179 213 px (0 at Yellow); em081_04 tikuden 0 calm / enraged (its aliased primitives are not lit in either state; the charge states not covered); em050_00 0 (UVViewNormal). Khezu (em003_00, the glb change; HEAD vs fix sequential runs, noise 6 / 35 px): 2967 px calm / 9758 enraged -- the red vein layer reads fainter and no longer bands across the chest; it pulses with the clip instead. MapBlend (the alias's first case and the shader line) exists on em063_05 alone (materials.json census; effect-materials.json has none). Sheets: `<scratchpad>/slimefix/shots/ab-sheet.png`, `khezu-sheet.png`, `aud-sheets/sheet-<id>.png` (HEAD | tree minus this fix | fix | diffs, calm over enraged, 13 monsters). Second half, same day: rom/shader.js's MapBlend mixed the raw second map into diffuseColor, dropping the material colour (`diffuse`); Raging's fDiffuseColor is 0,0,0, so Red drew a lit albedo over the emission. The lerp is on the albedo: `mix(diffuseColor.rgb, diffuse * ext.rgb, a)`. Rendered HEAD vs fix, same camera and pose: the slime pixels match (`<scratchpad>/slimefix/shots/head2-rest.png`, `fix2-rest.png`).
148. **A shell file's modes are not the class's repertoire (2026-10-25, Savage u 51).** A .shl names an ef for every mode it holds -- Savage's shell00 has sixteen, shell54 eight -- but the maker picks a mode from the action's own arguments, and the AI issues three of the 96 rock actions' groups. Read which actions reach the maker and which the command table issues (<archive>\gapR\sw7.py + rawrock.py) before calling a named record missing work.
149. **A probe's loop must be set before the clip is picked (2026-10-25, lane B).** `<archive>/cen/probe.mjs` set `V.state.loop` after `clipSel.onchange()`; the play stayed play-once, stopped on its last frame, and the class timers (which run on the motion's frames) stopped with it -- Seltas Queen's 3000-frame level timer never ran. `<archive>/laneB/probe2.mjs` sets it first.
150. **census3 caps a play at 900 frames (2026-10-25, lane B).** Lao-Shan Lung's attack clips run up to 1767 frames; 16 records past f900 read "never started". Play a clip whole when its bits lie past the cap (`<archive>/laneB/mkprobe.py`).
151. **A Parts sweep sets ONE row at a time (2026-10-25, lane B).** Drilltusk u 412 needs the Boulder at kind 1 AND the tusks broken; Daimyo's claw rungs and Rustrazor's shell type 4 did not fire under `partSweep` but did with the row set directly (or every row broken). A burn-out kept for one timer step reached the shells only when that frame happened to run an effect step: always under the meter (its getDelta is forced to 1/60), 0 of 5 at 144 Hz.
